# Golden source for T-14 (tests/conformance_highlight.rs): every token class once or more.
import "./users.rivet" as users public
global api = "https://api.example.com"   # base URL
global retry_on = [429, 503]

operation users.get
    description "Fetch one user by id"
    param id integer required min 1
    param tags list text optional
    output json
    r = http get "${api}/users/${id}"
        header "accept" "application/json"
        timeout "5s"
        decode json
    end
    message = "é ${id}"
    if r.status == 200 and not false
        return {user: r.body, code: retry_on.0, n: (length tags)}
    else
        fail "not_found" {id: id, other: (users.list {page: 1})}
    end
end
